participants.name: Access Policy

participants.name: Authority Management
participants.responsibility: Effective Actor/Action/ResponsibilityScope authority derived from membership, role and scope assignment facts.

participants.name: Resource Catalogue
participants.responsibility: Resource identity/lifecycle, at most one effective HostAddress-or-Prefix realization per Resource/time for current scope, scope affiliation/responsibility.

participants.name: Application Communication Catalogue
participants.responsibility: Application/Component/Interaction identities and immutable InteractionContractRevision traffic snapshots; Interactions are intra-Application.

participants.name: Application Deployment
participants.responsibility: Concrete ComponentDeployment identity/lifecycle and exact ComponentRef-to-ResourceRef deployment truth.

participants.name: Network Enforcement Placement
participants.responsibility: Candidate Firewall and policy-locator relevance for technical address pairs.

participants.name: Technical Access Evidence
participants.responsibility: Canonical normalized immutable source-qualified technical evidence with source/time/provenance.

participants.name: Access Policy Realization
participants.responsibility: Source-neutral realization assessment, semantic delta, accepted additive change design and verification.

participants.name: Network Environment Operations
participants.responsibility: Controlled target mutation identity, authority, preconditions, outcome and execution provenance.

invariants: Business Connectivity Need references stable Interaction meaning and remains distinct from concrete Policy Rule identity or authorization.
ACC owns Application/Component/Interaction/InteractionContractRevision semantics and Interactions only connect Components of the same Application.
Material Interaction traffic change creates a new immutable InteractionContractRevision without changing Interaction identity.
An exact InteractionContractRevision identifies its owning Interaction and endpoint Components, so consumers need no duplicate InteractionRef solely for interpretation.
Application Deployment owns ComponentDeployment identity and exact ComponentRef-to-ResourceRef deployment truth.
One ComponentDeployment references exactly one Component and one Resource for the first MVP; deploying the same Component on another Resource creates another ComponentDeployment.
Resource Catalogue owns Resource identity/lifecycle, scope affiliation/responsibility and effective AddressSpace; address changes do not change ComponentDeployment identity.
Access Policy is the single owner of one concrete Policy Rule lifecycle, including RuleChange attempts, formal decisions and current effective revision/withdrawal state.
A concrete Policy Rule connection is identified by its directed source/destination ComponentDeployment pair; revisionRef is current/proposed traffic semantics rather than connection identity.
RuleChange decision state is Pending, Accepted or Rejected; one Accepted applicable change may advance current policy.
Pending or Rejected revision changes never overwrite the current effective revision.
Customer-specific approval procedure, approver topology, quorum and Responsibility Scope-derived approval routing are outside the first-MVP Access Policy domain baseline.
Historical Accepted changes cannot silently restore withdrawn current authorization.
Authority Management remains the owner of actor/action/scope/time admission where protected actions use it; Resource responsibility metadata never substitutes for authority.
Evidence Access Recognition is a non-authoritative composition; ambiguous/missing correlation produces no access candidate.
Evidence alone never creates authorization, desired policy or remediation intent.
Required Policy Materialization is derived composition; one effective Rule names one concrete source/destination ComponentDeployment pair and is not replica-expanded.
Unresolved is not empty required policy or APR drift.
The first target-specific NEP edge accepts only HostAddress-to-HostAddress TrafficPairs; Prefix remains upstream truth and yields unresolved until Prefix-aware semantics are accepted.
TAE owns normalized evidence vocabulary/history while acquisition capabilities own source-specific collection/translation.
NEO is not the evidence-acquisition/read gateway; NEO owns controlled target mutation.
APR assessment, semantic delta and VerifiedChangeIntent remain source-neutral and additive-only for MVP missing permit space.
Provider rendering must preserve verified semantic intent and fail closed when equivalence cannot be established.
Applied or immediate execution Verified is not final semantic convergence proof.
No Shared Kernel is accepted between target Bounded Contexts.
explicit_future_extensions: Detailed BusinessProcess retirement/archive, criticality and duplicate-Need policy when a concrete journey requires them.
Customer-specific approval workflow integration, including bilateral/quorum/staged processes and Responsibility Scope-derived approver selection.
Whether several different ComponentDeployments may share one Resource.
ComponentDeployment runtime/container/pod identity and richer lifecycle/history.
ACC draft/publish/version-presentation workflow beyond immutable contract snapshots.
Nested groups, role inheritance, explicit deny/ABAC or quorum authority semantics.
Prefix-aware NEP TrafficPair routing/override matching semantics without host enumeration.
Managed-policy ownership and automatic removal/narrowing semantics for APR excess.
Richer APR remediation vocabulary or durable remediation-plan lifecycle beyond additive ENSURE-PERMIT.
Multiple simultaneous Resource addresses/prefixes, interfaces, endpoint purpose, VIP and deployment-specific network exposure.
Concrete acquisition scheduling/polling and production provider transport/rollback mechanisms.
